scope: PARTIAL Week11: 7 of 13 events have captured player prices: all 7 across all six standard categories. Remaining 6 event inventories had no targeted standard quotes observed. All 13 inventories were checked Nov17 16:15-16:25 CT; actual captured price times are per event and row. These are dated snapshots, not continuous or full-slate six-category coverage.
availability_note: Book listing and roster membership are not game clearance. Model figures retain their own older source times and have no new injury/workload adjustment. Book prices are comparisons only; no betting edge or current TN offer claimed.
